verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Ik'kot winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal, tzik'anpaxkot spichul heb' syak'och t'a yopisio t'a sakerdoteal. Tzik'paxkot akeite sk'anchaji a sik'chajkanoch heb' t'a yopisio chi'. Tzik'paxkot junok nok' kelem wakax ol ak'chaj silab'il yuj mul yet' chawanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' junok yune' mooch ixim pan malaj yich.
Tza molb'an heb' etchonhab' smasanil t'a sti' mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Moisés chi' icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová, ix molchaj anima smasanil t'a sti' mantiado chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Haton juntzanh tik ix yal Jehová to ol ko k'ulej, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh to snitzkot sb'a winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a stz'ey. Ix b'ikjiel heb' yuj winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'jioch skamix winhaj Aarón chi' yet' stzek'ul yuj winh yet' pax k'apak pichul jukan, k'apak chaleka yet' k'apak stzek'ul tz'isb'iloch yelwanub'.
Haxo t'a spatik k'apak chi', ix yak'paxoch jun k'apak smakul snhisk'ol winh, ha t'a yol k'apak chi' ix yak'och k'een Urim winh yet' k'een Tumim.

Ixlajwi chi' ix ak'jik'e sk'ox winh, haton jun k'apak ix b'ak'jioch t'a sjolom winh. Haxo t'a snanhal sat winh, ix ak'jioch jun k'een yelwanub' nab'a oro, haton sch'oxani to sik'b'iloch winh t'a sakerdoteal, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anchaanh akeite winhaj Moisés chi', haton sk'anchaji a sik'chajoch junok mach, ma junok tas tz'ochkan yikok Jehová. Ix stzikanem winh t'a yib'anh skajnub' Jehová yet' t'a yib'anh masanil tastak ayoch t'a yool chi'. Icha wal chi' ix aj yochkan masanil tastak chi' yikok Jehová.
Hanheja' jun akeite chi', ix tzikjiem ukel t'a yib'anh altar yet' t'a yib'anh masanil syamk'ab'il, t'a yib'anh jun niwan palangana yet' sb'akhnub' yich. Icha chi' ix aj yochkan yikok Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anpaxk'e akeite winhaj Moisés t'a sjolom winhaj Aarón yuj yochkan winh yikok Jehová.
Ix yik'anpaxkot heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi' winh t'a stz'ey. Ix ak'jioch spichul heb' jukan, stzek'ul heb' yet' sk'ox heb' yuj winh, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot nok' kelem wakax winh, nok' ol och t'a silab'il yuj mul. Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal, ix yak'k'e sk'ab' heb' t'a sjolom nok'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix smilancham nok' winh. Ix yik'anb'at schiq'uil nok' winh, ix sukanoch winh yet' yiximal sk'ab' t'a sch'ak altar ayk'e t'a schikintak schanhil, yik wach' chab'il yuj Dios. Haxo jantakto chik' ixto kan chi', ix stob'kanem winh t'a yichtak altar chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yochkan yikok Jehová, yik wach' slajwikanel chukal ta'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anelta masanil xepual nok' winh ayoch t'a nok' yol sk'ool yet' t'a yib'anh seyub' nok', nok' stut schab'il yet' xepual ayoch t'ay. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix snhustz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar.
Haxo jantakto nok' wakax chi' ix kani, haton stz'umal nok' yet' sb'ak'chil nok' yet' sch'anhtza' nok', ix ak'chajkanoch sk'ak'al t'a spatikelta kampamento, icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ix yak'anpax ik'jokkot nok' kalnel winh snhusjitz'a smasanil silab'il. Haxo winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal chi', ix yak'k'e sk'ab' heb' t'a sjolom nok'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix smilancham nok' winhaj Moisés chi', ix stzikanoch schiq'uil nok' winh t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.
Ix skotak xikej nok' winh, ix snhusantz'a sjolom nok' winh yet' nok' chok' yaj chi' yet' sxepual nok'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix smaxan nok' yol sk'ool winh yet' nok' yok. Ix snhusantz'a nok' winh smasanil silab'il t'a yib'anh altar. Ha jun ofrenda chi' te suk'uq'ui sjab' ix yab' Jehová, icha wal ix aj yalani.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an ik'jokkot junxo nok' ch'ak kalnel winh yik sk'anchaji yik tz'ochkan heb' t'a yopisio. Haxo winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal chi', ix yak'k'e sk'ab' heb' t'a sjolom nok'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix smilancham nok' winh, ix yik'anb'at jab'ok schiq'uil nok' winh, ix sukanoch winh t'a sjayil schikin winhaj Aarón t'a swach', t'a smam sk'ab' winh t'a swach' yet' t'a yiximal smam yok winh t'a swach'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh to snitzkot sb'a heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi' t'a stz'ey, ix yak'anpaxoch schiq'uil nok' chi' winh t'a sjayil schikin heb' t'a swach' yet' t'a smam sk'ab' heb' t'a swach' yet' t'a yiximal smam yok heb' t'a swach'. Ixlajwi chi' ix stzikanoch winh jantakto chik' ixto kan t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anelta xepu' winh ayoch t'a nok' snhe yet' ayoch t'a nok' yol sk'ool, xepu' ayoch t'a yib'anh seyub' nok' yet' nok' stut schab'il yet' xepu' ayoch t'ay yet' nok' xub' t'a swach'.

Ix yik'ankot jun yune' mooch ixim pan winh malaj yich, ix yak'och winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ix yik'ank'eta jun ixim pan chi' winh t'a yol mooch chi' yet' junxo ixim kalab'il yet' akeite yet' jun ixim k'oxox b'ob'il t'a ixim harina, ix yak'ank'e winh t'a yib'anh nok' xepu' chi' yet' t'a yib'anh nok' xub' t'a swach'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an masanil juntzanh tik winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal, yik sb'akhanek' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anpaxek' masanil juntzanh chi' winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb', ix snhusantz'a winh smasanil t'a yib'anh altar yet' nok' silab' ix nhusjitz'a t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj sik'chajoch heb' t'a yopisio. Te suk'uq'ui sjab' ix yab' Jehová.
Ix yik'anpaxkot snhisk'ol nok' kalnel winh ix ak'ji yuj sik'chajkanoch heb' t'a yopisio. Ix sb'akhanoch heb' t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha jun chi' ix yik'kan winhaj Moisés chi' icha ix aj yalan Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot akeite winh yet' chik' ayek' t'a yib'anh altar. Ix stzikank'e winh t'a yib'anh winhaj Aarón yet' t'a spichul. Ix tzikanpaxk'e winh t'a yib'anh heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi' yet' t'a spichul heb'. Icha chi' ix aj yochkan heb' yikok Jehová yet' spichul smasanil.

Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal chi': Tz'anhjokab' nok' chib'ej t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Hata' tze chi nok' yet' ixim pan ayem t'a yol jun yune' mooch, haton ixim ix ak'ji yik tzex ochkan t'a eyopisio. Icha ix aj walani: Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal ol swa jun wael tik heb', xin chi, ix walani.
Ha jantakto manh ol lajwok nok' chib'ej chi' yet' ixim pan chi' eyuuj, ol he nhuskantz'aok.
Ha t'a yichanh k'apak mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová, anhej ta' tzex aj ukeok k'ual masanto sk'och sk'ual eyochkan t'a eyopisio.
Ha tiknaik toxo ix b'o icha wal ix aj schekan Jehová ko k'ulej yik slajwikanel he mul.

Yuj chi' ha t'a yichanh mantiado, hata' tzex kan ukeok k'ual yet' ukeok ak'wal. Tze k'anab'ajan masanil juntzanh scheknab'il Jehová yik wach' max ex chami, yujto icha chi' ix aj yalan Jehová chi' t'ayin, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Icha chi' ix aj sk'anab'ajan winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal masanil tas ix schek Jehová yal winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb'.
